title: Troubleshoot the path, not the symptom
points: Map client, DNS, edge, load balancer, compute, data and dependencies. Locate the first failing boundary with metrics, logs and traces before changing configuration.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Start with an architecture and evidence map
points: Neutral topology with owners, request path, health signal and recent change. Compare expected vs observed behavior, then narrow to a hypothesis; reveal cause only after evidence.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Read the error at its source
points: Distinguish DNS resolution, TCP connection, TLS handshake, HTTP status and application errors; each layer has different evidence and corrective owner.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: EC2 is unreachable
points: Client reaches a public EC2 instance over TCP 22. Use Reachability Analyzer from internet gateway to instance ENI to isolate the missing inbound SSH security-group rule, then test SSH from the approved client.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: private EC2 has no egress
points: Trace private subnet default route to NAT gateway, NAT public subnet route to IGW, SG/NACL and DNS. Fix missing or wrong route; validate outbound connection without adding an inbound opening.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: private service endpoint fails
points: Compare endpoint service/Region, VPC DNS, route or private DNS, endpoint security group and policy. Fix the failing boundary and validate from the application subnet.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: hybrid DNS answer is wrong
points: Trace Route 53 Resolver inbound/outbound endpoints, forwarding rule association, private hosted zone and on-premises DNS conditional forwarder. Test exact domain from each side.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: ALB targets are unhealthy
points: Client -> ALB listener -> target group -> app port/path. Examine target health reason, app response, SG and health-check path; fix /ready versus /health only if application confirms it.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: TLS fails at the edge
points: Check certificate name, chain, expiry, CloudFront/ALB listener placement and client SNI. Renew or attach the correct ACM certificate in the required scope; verify handshake.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: cross-account access denied
points: Trace caller policy, assumed-role trust, resource policy, SCP, permission boundary and KMS key policy. Use CloudTrail denial and policy simulation to identify the actual explicit deny or missing allow.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: S3 AccessDenied
points: Inspect object/key, bucket policy, IAM identity, Block Public Access, encryption and KMS key policy. Fix the least-privilege policy layer, then test exact caller and action.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: KMS decrypt breaks a workload
points: Trace encrypted data key, principal, KMS key policy, IAM permission and grants in the correct Region. Confirm key state and encryption context; retest with the service principal.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: database latency spikes
points: Trace ALB/application latency to RDS CPU, connections, locks, I/O and query performance. Distinguish query/index issue from capacity and failover; measure p95 after one controlled change.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: DynamoDB throttles
points: Compare hot partition, key design, consumed capacity, on-demand/provisioned mode and GSI write limits. Redistribute key load or capacity with retry backoff; verify throttled requests.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: queue backlog grows
points: Inspect SQS oldest message age, Lambda/ECS consumer concurrency, errors, visibility timeout and DLQ. Isolate poison messages or scale workers without duplicating side effects.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: Lambda times out
points: Check duration, timeout setting, memory/CPU, VPC route, downstream latency and retries in CloudWatch logs/traces. Fix the dependency or timeout appropriately and retest idempotency.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: ECS rollout rolls back
points: Trace deployment event, task image, secrets, health check, service capacity and target group. Correct failing task or health gate, redeploy and verify steady state.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: EKS pod crash loops
points: Inspect pod events, container logs, image pull, startup/liveness probes, secret/config and resource limits. Correct the failing condition and validate ready replicas.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: CloudWatch logs are missing
points: Trace producer -> agent/runtime -> IAM role -> log group/stream -> Region and retention. Send a test event; separate collection failure from delayed ingestion or wrong query.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: alert storm after deploy
points: Correlate deploy time, p95, error rate, dependency metrics and SLO. Pause rollout or roll back when customer impact is confirmed; reduce duplicate alarm noise after recovery.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: Bedrock invocation denied
points: Inspect caller role, bedrock:InvokeModel permission, model ARN/Region and model access conditions; use CloudTrail error evidence. Correct scope and retest exact model ID.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: RAG answers are stale
points: Trace document version, ingestion job, vector index, retrieval filters and model prompt. Upload revised source, run sync, inspect retrieved chunks and compare answer with citations.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: NAT cost spikes
points: Cost Explorer usage type and Region -> NAT bytes -> VPC Flow Logs/top talkers -> destination. Consider gateway/interface endpoint or AZ-aware route only after confirming path and pricing.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Walkthrough: failover does not restore users
points: Check secondary data freshness, endpoint health, capacity, DNS cache or ARC routing state and user journey. Restore missing dependency, shift traffic safely and measure RTO/RPO.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Use controlled remediation
points: Guard automation with ownership, rate limits, approval, idempotency, rollback and post-change verification. Circuit breakers and bounded retries prevent amplification.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Runbook: diagnose, change, verify
points: Operational sequence: capture evidence, state hypothesis, apply smallest reversible change, compare user-facing metric, record rollback and handoff. Systems Manager Automation may execute approved steps.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Incident signal to action decision table
points: Grid: connection timeout -> network path; 5xx -> target/app logs; AccessDenied -> policy context; throttling -> capacity/key; stale answer -> ingestion/retrieval; missing logs -> delivery chain.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification

title: Practical lab completion checklist
points: For each lab record neutral architecture, symptom, evidence, hypothesis, exact console change, successful verification, rollback and prevention. Remember: a green icon is not proof without observed service recovery.
layout: neutral architecture, evidence, corrective boundary and observable verification
